RQ: How effective are combinations of security design patterns compared with their individual components in preventing vulnerabilities in Ethereum smart contracts?
report_note: Working baseline scripts/test-results.json absent at inspection; saved pinned report lists 16 AC files. Actual 33-file reproduction supported separately by saved baseline-tests.log, not new protected results.
